title: Insurance Agent Policy Document Assistant

blueprintSignals.name: Citation validity
blueprintSignals.definition: share of statements supported by the cited clause
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: A real clause can still not support the statement, so test entailment

blueprintSignals.name: Version match
blueprintSignals.definition: whether the version cited is the one in force at the policy date

blueprintSignals.name: Escalation precision
blueprintSignals.definition: share of escalations that an underwriter agrees were needed
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Over-refusal makes the assistant unhelpful, so track both

blueprintSignals.name: Retrieval recall
blueprintSignals.definition: share of questions where the relevant clause is in the top k results
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Gold sets are costly to build

label: For "Insurance Agent Policy Document Assistant": Answer agents' and brokers' questions about product features, exclusions and underwriting rules from the insurer's current documents, with citations. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Testing only on current documents hides failures on older versions agents still sell.
